appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Dark Mode is the default. VocalFlow uses one green accent for controls and highlights.

language.title: Language
language.description: Switch the desktop UI between English and Chinese. CLI output remains English.

hf.title: HuggingFace token
hf.description: Optional. Speeds up model downloads (audio-separator, faster-whisper) and avoids 429 rate limits when the desktop pulls models for the first time. Stored locally; injected as HF_TOKEN env var into CLI subprocesses.
hf.notSet: No token set — anonymous downloads are rate-limited.

endpoint.title: HuggingFace mirror
endpoint.description: Optional. Routes every HuggingFace download through a mirror host. Use https://hf-mirror.com if huggingface.co is unreachable on your network.

separator.title: Backing creation models folder
separator.description: Optional. Reuse pre-downloaded audio-separator models (.onnx / .pth / .ckpt) instead of fetching from HuggingFace. Auto-linked from Ultimate Vocal Remover when installed; you can also point this at any folder.
separator.notSet: Using audio-separator's default cache (downloads from HuggingFace on first use).
separator.autoBody: Linked {{count}} model file(s) from your Ultimate Vocal Remover install. The desktop will pass {{model}} to audio-separator so the run stays offline.
